Dr. Amara Okafor — Soft Skin Mechanics said about it: The Convert Durometer to Young's Modulus (E4) gives about 0.667 MPa for Shore A 10 silicone, soft enough for the 1 mN spot above yet moldable and durable, and the edge must be primer-bonded and clamped to a nail-backed core so grip load goes into the finger while the soft stack above transduction stays under 2.5 mm thick per the GelSight: High-Resolution Robot Tactile Sensors for Estimating Geometry and Force (E2).
